name: MCP Integration
purpose: Expose semantic, bounded tools and resources over Model Context Protocol: well-named tools with JSON Schema I/O, paginated resources, typed error envelopes, and least-privilege scopes, never arbitrary shell or unrestricted filesystem access by default.
inputs: MCP protocol version under test and client set
Domain operations to expose with current auth model and rate limits
Data-sensitivity map of fields that must never cross the tool boundary
Deployment topology and the OAuth provider issuing scopes
outputs: MCP integration specification with tool catalog, schemas, scopes, and error contracts
Scoped server implementation with strict schemas, confirm gates, and audit logging
Probe, load, and audit evidence archived with the release under test
stop_conditions: All exposed tools pass schema-strictness, scope, error-probe, and load gates with evidence
Zero god tools on the surface; every destructive tool carries a confirm gate
